versos.hebraico: וְאִשָּׁ֣ה אַחַ֣ת מִנְּשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־הַ֠נְּבִיאִים צָעֲקָ֨ה אֶל־אֱלִישָׁ֜ע לֵאמֹ֗ר עַבְדְּךָ֤ אִישִׁי֙ מֵ֔ת וְאַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתָּ כִּ֣י עַבְדְּךָ֔ הָיָ֥ה יָרֵ֖א אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה וְהַ֨נֹּשֶׁ֔ה בָּ֗א לָקַ֜חַת אֶת־שְׁנֵ֧י יְלָדַ֛י ל֖וֹ לַעֲבָדִֽים׃

controles.web: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets to Elisha, saying, “Your servant my husband is dead. You know that your servant feared Yahweh. Now the creditor has come to take for himself my two children to be slaves.”
controles.kjv: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the Lord: and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.
controles.livre: Uma mulher, das mulheres dos filhos dos profetas, clamou a Eliseu, dizendo: Teu servo, meu marido, é morto; e tu sabes que teu servo era temeroso ao SENHOR; e veio o credor para tomar-se dois filhos meus por servos.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלֶ֤יהָ אֱלִישָׁע֙ מָ֣ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־לָּ֔ךְ הַגִּ֣ידִי לִ֔י מַה־יֶּשׁ־לכי בַּבָּ֑יִת וַתֹּ֗אמֶר אֵ֣ין לְשִׁפְחָתְךָ֥ כֹל֙ בַּבַּ֔יִת כִּ֖י אִם־אָס֥וּךְ שָֽׁמֶן׃

controles.web: Elisha said to her, “What shall I do for you? Tell me: what do you have in the house?”   She said, “Your handmaid has nothing in the house, except a pot of oil.”
controles.kjv: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.
controles.livre: E Eliseu lhe disse: que te farei eu? Declara-me o que tens em casa. E ela disse: Tua serva nenhuma coisa tem em casa, a não ser uma botija de azeite.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לְכִ֨י שַׁאֲלִי־לָ֤ךְ כֵּלִים֙ מִן־הַח֔וּץ מֵאֵ֖ת כָּל־שכנכי כֵּלִ֥ים רֵקִ֖ים אַל־תַּמְעִֽיטִי׃

controles.web: Then he said, “Go, borrow containers from of all your neighbors, even empty containers. Don’t borrow just a few.
controles.kjv: Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.
controles.livre: E ele lhe disse: Vai, e pede para ti vasos emprestados de todos teus vizinhos, vasos vazios, não poucos.

versos.hebraico: וּבָ֗את וְסָגַ֤רְתְּ הַדֶּ֨לֶת֙ בַּעֲדֵ֣ךְ וּבְעַד־בָּנַ֔יִךְ וְיָצַ֕קְתְּ עַ֥ל כָּל־הַכֵּלִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְהַמָּלֵ֖א תַּסִּֽיעִי׃

controles.web: You shall go in, and shut the door on you and on your sons, and pour out into all those containers; and you shall set aside that which is full.”
controles.kjv: And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.
controles.livre: Entra logo, e fecha a porta atrás de ti e atrás teus filhos; e deita em todos os vasos, e em estando um cheio, põe-o à parte.

versos.hebraico: וַתֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ מֵֽאִתּ֔וֹ וַתִּסְגֹּ֣ר הַדֶּ֔לֶת בַּעֲדָ֖הּ וּבְעַ֣ד בָּנֶ֑יהָ הֵ֛ם מַגִּשִׁ֥ים אֵלֶ֖יהָ וְהִ֥יא מיצקת׃

controles.web: So she went from him, and shut the door on her and on her sons; they brought the containers to her, and she poured out.
controles.kjv: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.
controles.livre: E partiu-se a mulher dele, e fechou a porta atrás si e atrás seus filhos; e eles lhe traziam os vasos, e ela deitava do azeite.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כִּמְלֹ֣את הַכֵּלִ֗ים וַתֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־בְּנָהּ֙ הַגִּ֨ישָׁה אֵלַ֥י עוֹד֙ כֶּ֔לִי וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֔יהָ אֵ֥ין ע֖וֹד כֶּ֑לִי וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֖ד הַשָּֽׁמֶן׃

controles.web: When the containers were full, she said to her son, “Bring me another container.”   He said to her, “There isn’t another container.” The oil stopped flowing.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.
controles.livre: E quando os vasos foram cheios, disse a um filho seu: Traze-me ainda outro vaso. E ele disse: Não há mais vasos. Então cessou o azeite.

versos.hebraico: וַתָּבֹ֗א וַתַּגֵּד֙ לְאִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לְכִי֙ מִכְרִ֣י אֶת־הַשֶּׁ֔מֶן וְשַׁלְּמִ֖י אֶת־נשיכי וְאַ֣תְּ בניכי תִֽחְיִ֖י בַּנּוֹתָֽר׃פ

controles.web: Then she came and told the man of God. He said, “Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt; and you and your sons live on the rest.”
controles.kjv: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.
controles.livre: Veio ela logo, e contou-o ao homem de Deus, o qual disse: Vai, e vende o azeite, e paga a teus credores; e tu e teus filhos vivei do que restar.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֨י הַיּ֜וֹם וַיַּעֲבֹ֧ר אֱלִישָׁ֣ע אֶל־שׁוּנֵ֗ם וְשָׁם֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וַתַּחֲזֶק־בּ֖וֹ לֶאֱכָל־לָ֑חֶם וַֽיְהִי֙ מִדֵּ֣י עָבְר֔וֹ יָסֻ֥ר שָׁ֖מָּה לֶאֱכָל־לָֽחֶם׃

controles.web: It fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where there was a prominent woman; and she persuaded him to eat bread. So it was, that as often as he passed by, he turned in there to eat bread.
controles.kjv: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.
controles.livre: E aconteceu também que um dia passava Eliseu por Suném; e havia ali uma mulher rica, a qual lhe constrangeu a que comesse do pão; e quando por ali passava, vinha-se à sua casa a comer do pão.

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל־אִישָׁ֔הּ הִנֵּה־נָ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ אֱלֹהִ֖ים קָד֣וֹשׁ ה֑וּא עֹבֵ֥ר עָלֵ֖ינוּ תָּמִֽיד׃

controles.web: She said to her husband, “See now, I perceive that this is a holy man of God, that passes by us continually.
controles.kjv: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.
controles.livre: E ela disse a seu marido: Eis que agora, eu entendo que este que sempre passa por nossa casa, é homem de Deus santo.

versos.hebraico: נַֽעֲשֶׂה־נָּ֤א עֲלִיַּת־קִיר֙ קְטַנָּ֔ה וְנָשִׂ֨ים ל֥וֹ שָׁ֛ם מִטָּ֥ה וְשֻׁלְחָ֖ן וְכִסֵּ֣א וּמְנוֹרָ֑ה וְהָיָ֛ה בְּבֹא֥וֹ אֵלֵ֖ינוּ יָס֥וּר שָֽׁמָּה׃

controles.web: Please let us make a little room on the wall. Let us set for him there a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp stand. It shall be, when he comes to us, that he shall turn in there.”
controles.kjv: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.
controles.livre: Eu te rogo que faças uma pequena câmara de paredes, e ponhamos nela cama, e mesa, e cadeira, e candelabro, para que quando vier a nós, se recolha nela.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֥י הַיּ֖וֹם וַיָּ֣בֹא שָׁ֑מָּה וַיָּ֥סַר אֶל־הָעֲלִיָּ֖ה וַיִּשְׁכַּב־שָֽׁמָּה׃

controles.web: One day he came there, and he turned into the room and lay there.
controles.kjv: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que um dia veio ele por ali, e recolheu-se naquela câmara, e dormiu nela.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל־גֵּחֲזִ֣י נַעֲר֔וֹ קְרָ֖א לַשּׁוּנַמִּ֣ית הַזֹּ֑את וַיִּקְרָא־לָ֔הּ וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֖ד לְפָנָֽיו׃

controles.web: He said to Gehazi his servant, “Call this Shunammite.” When he had called her, she stood before him.
controles.kjv: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.
controles.livre: Então disse a Geazi seu criado: Chama a esta sunamita. E quando ele a chamou, ela se apresentou diante dele.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ אֱמָר־נָ֣א אֵלֶיהָ֮ הִנֵּ֣ה חָרַ֣דְתְּ׀ אֵלֵינוּ֮ אֶת־כָּל־הַחֲרָדָ֣ה הַזֹּאת֒ מֶ֚ה לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָ֔ךְ הֲיֵ֤שׁ לְדַבֶּר־לָךְ֙ אֶל־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ א֖וֹ אֶל־שַׂ֣ר הַצָּבָ֑א וַתֹּ֕אמֶר בְּת֥וֹךְ עַמִּ֖י אָנֹכִ֥י יֹשָֽׁבֶת׃

controles.web: He said to him, “Say now to her, ‘Behold, you have cared for us with all this care. What is to be done for you? Would you like to be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the army?’”   She answered, “I dwell among my own people.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among mine own people.
controles.livre: E disse ele a Geazi: Dize-lhe: Eis que tu tens sido prestativa por nós com todo este esmero: que queres que eu faça por ti? Tens necessidade que fale por ti ao rei, ou ao general do exército? E ela respondeu: Eu habito em meio de meu povo.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר וּמֶ֖ה לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָ֑הּ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר גֵּיחֲזִ֗י אֲבָ֛ל בֵּ֥ן אֵֽין־לָ֖הּ וְאִישָׁ֥הּ זָקֵֽן׃

controles.web: He said, “What then is to be done for her?”   Gehazi answered, “Most certainly she has no son, and her husband is old.”
controles.kjv: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.
controles.livre: E ele disse: Que, pois, faremos por ela? E Geazi respondeu: Eis que ela não tem filho, e seu marido é velho.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר קְרָא־לָ֑הּ וַיִּקְרָא־לָ֔הּ וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֖ד בַּפָּֽתַח׃

controles.web: He said, “Call her.” When he had called her, she stood in the door.
controles.kjv: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.
controles.livre: Disse então: Chama-a. E ele a chamou, e ela se parou à porta.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לַמּוֹעֵ֤ד הַזֶּה֙ כָּעֵ֣ת חַיָּ֔ה אתי חֹבֶ֣קֶת בֵּ֑ן וַתֹּ֗אמֶר אַל־אֲדֹנִי֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אַל־תְּכַזֵּ֖ב בְּשִׁפְחָתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: He said, “At this season, when the time comes around, you will embrace a son.”   She said, “No, my lord, you man of God, do not lie to your handmaid.”
controles.kjv: And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.
controles.livre: E ele lhe disse: A este tempo segundo o tempo da vida, abraçarás um filho. E ela disse: Não, senhor meu, homem de Deus, não mintas para tua serva.

versos.hebraico: וַתַּ֥הַר הָאִשָּׁ֖ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן לַמּוֹעֵ֤ד הַזֶּה֙ כָּעֵ֣ת חַיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יהָ אֱלִישָֽׁע׃

controles.web: The woman conceived, and bore a son at that season, when the time came around, as Elisha had said to her.
controles.kjv: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.
controles.livre: Mas a mulher concebeu, e pariu um filho a aquele tempo que Eliseu lhe havia dito, segundo o tempo da vida.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּגְדַּ֖ל הַיָּ֑לֶד וַיְהִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם וַיֵּצֵ֥א אֶל־אָבִ֖יו אֶל־הַקֹּצְרִֽים׃

controles.web: When the child was grown, one day he went out to his father to the reapers.
controles.kjv: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.
controles.livre: E quando o menino foi grande, aconteceu que um dia saiu a seu pai, aos ceifeiros.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־אָבִ֖יו רֹאשִׁ֣י׀ רֹאשִׁ֑י וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל־הַנַּ֔עַר שָׂאֵ֖הוּ אֶל־אִמּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He said to his father, “My head! My head!”   He said to his servant, “Carry him to his mother.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.
controles.livre: E disse a seu pai: Minha cabeça, minha cabeça! E ele disse a um criado: Leva-o a sua mãe.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשָּׂאֵ֔הוּ וַיְבִיאֵ֖הוּ אֶל־אִמּ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֧שֶׁב עַל־בִּרְכֶּ֛יהָ עַד־הַֽצָּהֳרַ֖יִם וַיָּמֹֽת׃

controles.web: When he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees until noon, and then died.
controles.kjv: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.
controles.livre: E havendo-lhe ele tomado, e trazido-o a sua mãe, esteve sentado sobre seus joelhos até meio dia, e morreu-se.

versos.hebraico: וַתַּ֨עַל֙ וַתַּשְׁכִּבֵ֔הוּ עַל־מִטַּ֖ת אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַתִּסְגֹּ֥ר בַּעֲד֖וֹ וַתֵּצֵֽא׃

controles.web: She went up and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door on him, and went out.
controles.kjv: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door upon him, and went out.
controles.livre: Ela então subiu, e o pôs sobre a cama do homem de Deus, e fechando-lhe a porta, saiu-se.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּקְרָא֮ אֶל־אִישָׁהּ֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר שִׁלְחָ֨ה נָ֥א לִי֙ אֶחָ֣ד מִן־הַנְּעָרִ֔ים וְאַחַ֖ת הָאֲתֹנ֑וֹת וְאָר֛וּצָה עַד־אִ֥ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים וְאָשֽׁוּבָה׃

controles.web: She called to her husband, and said, “Please send me one of the servants, and one of the donkeys, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.”
controles.kjv: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.
controles.livre: Chamando logo a seu marido, disse-lhe: Rogo-te que envies comigo a algum dos criados e uma das asnas, para que eu vá correndo ao homem de Deus, e volte.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מַ֠דּוּעַ אתי הלכתי אֵלָיו֙ הַיּ֔וֹם לֹֽא־חֹ֖דֶשׁ וְלֹ֣א שַׁבָּ֑ת וַתֹּ֖אמֶר שָׁלֽוֹם׃

controles.web: He said, “Why would you want go to him today? It is neither new moon nor Sabbath.”   She said, “It’s alright.”
controles.kjv: And he said, Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day? it is neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, It shall be well.
controles.livre: E ele disse: Para que hás de ir a ele hoje? Não é nova lua, nem sábado. E ela respondeu: Paz.

versos.hebraico: וַֽתַּחֲבֹשׁ֙ הָֽאָת֔וֹן וַתֹּ֥אמֶר אֶֽל־נַעֲרָ֖הּ נְהַ֣ג וָלֵ֑ךְ אַל־תַּעֲצָר־לִ֣י לִרְכֹּ֔ב כִּ֖י אִם־אָמַ֥רְתִּי לָֽךְ׃

controles.web: Then she saddled a donkey, and said to her servant, “Drive, and go forward! Don’t slow down for me, unless I ask you to.”
controles.kjv: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not thy riding for me, except I bid thee.
controles.livre: Depois fez preparar uma jumenta, e disse ao jovem: Guia e anda; e não me faças deter para que suba, a não ser quando eu te disser.

versos.hebraico: וַתֵּ֗לֶךְ וַתָּב֛וֹא אֶל־אִ֥ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־הַ֣ר הַכַּרְמֶ֑ל וַ֠יְהִי כִּרְא֨וֹת אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִ֤ים אֹתָהּ֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶד וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל־גֵּיחֲזִ֣י נַעֲר֔וֹ הִנֵּ֖ה הַשּׁוּנַמִּ֥ית הַלָּֽז׃

controles.web: So she went, and came to the man of God to Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her afar off, he said to Gehazi his servant, “Behold, there is the Shunammite.
controles.kjv: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, yonder is that Shunammite:
controles.livre: Partiu-se, pois, e veio ao homem de Deus ao monte do Carmelo. E quando o homem de Deus a viu de longe, disse a seu criado Geazi: Eis que a sunamita:

versos.hebraico: עַתָּה֮ רֽוּץ־נָ֣א לִקְרָאתָהּ֒ וֶאֱמָר־לָ֗הּ הֲשָׁל֥וֹם לָ֛ךְ הֲשָׁל֥וֹם לְאִישֵׁ֖ךְ הֲשָׁל֣וֹם לַיָּ֑לֶד וַתֹּ֖אמֶר שָׁלֽוֹם׃

controles.web: Please run now to meet her, and ask her, ‘Is it well with you? Is it well with your husband? Is it well with the child?’”   She answered, “It is well.”
controles.kjv: Run now, I pray thee, to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well with thee? is it well with thy husband? is it well with the child? And she answered, It is well.
controles.livre: Rogo-te que vás agora correndo a recebê-la, e dize-lhe: Há paz contigo, com teu marido, e com teu filho? E ela disse: Paz.

versos.hebraico: וַתָּבֹ֞א אֶל־אִ֤ישׁ הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־הָהָ֔ר וַֽתַּחֲזֵ֖ק בְּרַגְלָ֑יו וַיִּגַּ֨שׁ גֵּֽיחֲזִ֜י לְהָדְפָ֗הּ וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אִ֨ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֤ים הַרְפֵּֽה־לָהּ֙ כִּֽי־נַפְשָׁ֣הּ מָֽרָה־לָ֔הּ וַֽיהוָה֙ הֶעְלִ֣ים מִמֶּ֔נִּי וְלֹ֥א הִגִּ֖יד לִֽי׃

controles.web: When she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught hold of his feet. Gehazi came near to thrust her away; but the man of God said, “Leave her alone; for her soul is troubled within her; and Yahweh has hidden it from me, and has not told me.”
controles.kjv: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of God said, Let her alone; for her soul is vexed within her: and the Lord hath hid it from me, and hath not told me.
controles.livre: E logo que chegou ao homem de Deus no monte, pegou seus pés. E chegou-se Geazi para tirá-la; mas o homem de Deus lhe disse: Deixa-a, porque sua alma está em amargura, e o SENHOR me encobriu o motivo, e não me revelou.

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּ֕אמֶר הֲשָׁאַ֥לְתִּי בֵ֖ן מֵאֵ֣ת אֲדֹנִ֑י הֲלֹ֣א אָמַ֔רְתִּי לֹ֥א תַשְׁלֶ֖ה אֹתִֽי׃

controles.web: Then she said, “Did I desire a son of my lord? Didn’t I say, Do not deceive me?”
controles.kjv: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?
controles.livre: E ela disse: Pedi eu filho a meu senhor? Não disse eu, que não me enganasses?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לְגֵיחֲזִ֜י חֲגֹ֣ר מָתְנֶ֗יךָ וְקַ֨ח מִשְׁעַנְתִּ֣י בְיָדְךָ֮ וָלֵךְ֒ כִּֽי־תִמְצָ֥א אִישׁ֙ לֹ֣א תְבָרְכֶ֔נּוּ וְכִֽי־יְבָרֶכְךָ֥ אִ֖ישׁ לֹ֣א תַעֲנֶנּ֑וּ וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ מִשְׁעַנְתִּ֖י עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַנָּֽעַר׃

controles.web: Then he said to Gehazi, “Tuck your cloak into your belt, take my staff in your hand, and go your way. If you meet any man, don’t greet him; and if anyone greets you, don’t answer him again. Then lay my staff on the face of the child.”
controles.kjv: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thine hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.
controles.livre: Então disse ele a Geazi: Cinge teus lombos, e toma meu bordão em tua mão, e vai; e se alguém te encontrar, não o saúdes; e se alguém te saudar, não lhe respondas: e porás meu bordão sobre o rosto do menino.

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֵ֣ם הַנַּ֔עַר חַי־יְהוָ֥ה וְחֵֽי־נַפְשְׁךָ֖ אִם־אֶעֶזְבֶ֑ךָּ וַיָּ֖קָם וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ אַחֲרֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: The mother of the child said, “As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.”   He arose, and followed her.
controles.kjv: And the mother of the child said, As the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And he arose, and followed her.
controles.livre: E disse a mãe do menino: Vive o SENHOR, e vive tua alma, que não te deixarei.

versos.hebraico: וְגֵחֲזִ֞י עָבַ֣ר לִפְנֵיהֶ֗ם וַיָּ֤שֶׂם אֶת־הַמִּשְׁעֶ֨נֶת֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַנַּ֔עַר וְאֵ֥ין ק֖וֹל וְאֵ֣ין קָ֑שֶׁב וַיָּ֤שָׁב לִקְרָאתוֹ֙ וַיַּגֶּד־ל֣וֹ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א הֵקִ֖יץ הַנָּֽעַר׃

controles.web: Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff on the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Therefore he returned to meet him, and told him, saying, “The child has not awakened.”
controles.kjv: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.
controles.livre: Ele então se levantou, e seguiu-a. E Geazi havia ido diante deles, e havia posto o bordão sobre o rosto do menino, mas nem tinha voz nem sentido; e assim se havia voltado para encontrar a Eliseu; e declarou-o a ele, dizendo: O jovem não desperta.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֥א אֱלִישָׁ֖ע הַבָּ֑יְתָה וְהִנֵּ֤ה הַנַּ֨עַר֙ מֵ֔ת מֻשְׁכָּ֖ב עַל־מִטָּתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: When Elisha had come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid on his bed.
controles.kjv: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.
controles.livre: E vindo Eliseu à casa, eis que o menino que estava estendido morto sobre sua cama.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֕א וַיִּסְגֹּ֥ר הַדֶּ֖לֶת בְּעַ֣ד שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל־יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: He went in therefore, and shut the door on them both, and prayed to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto the Lord.
controles.livre: Entrando ele então, fechou a porta sobre ambos, e orou ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֜עַל וַיִּשְׁכַּ֣ב עַל־הַיֶּ֗לֶד וַיָּשֶׂם֩ פִּ֨יו עַל־פִּ֜יו וְעֵינָ֤יו עַל־עֵינָיו֙ וְכַפָּ֣יו עַל־כפו וַיִּגְהַ֖ר עָלָ֑יו וַיָּ֖חָם בְּשַׂ֥ר הַיָּֽלֶד׃

controles.web: He went up, and lay on the child, and put his mouth on his mouth, and his eyes on his eyes, and his hands on his hands. He stretched himself on him; and the flesh of the child grew warm.
controles.kjv: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.
controles.livre: Depois subiu, e lançou-se sobre o menino, pondo sua boca sobre a boca dele, e seus olhos sobre seus olhos, e suas mãos sobre as mãos suas; assim se estendeu sobre ele, e aqueceu a carne do jovem.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֜שָׁב וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ בַּבַּ֗יִת אַחַ֥ת הֵ֨נָּה֙ וְאַחַ֣ת הֵ֔נָּה וַיַּ֖עַל וַיִּגְהַ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וַיְזוֹרֵ֤ר הַנַּ֨עַר֙ עַד־שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֔ים וַיִּפְקַ֥ח הַנַּ֖עַר אֶת־עֵינָֽיו׃

controles.web: Then he returned, and walked in the house once back and forth; and went up, and stretched himself on him. Then the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
controles.kjv: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
controles.livre: Voltando-se logo, andou pela casa a uma parte e a outra, e depois subiu, e estendeu-se sobre ele; e o jovem espirrou sete vezes, e abriu seus olhos.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֣א אֶל־גֵּיחֲזִ֗י וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ קְרָא֙ אֶל־הַשֻּׁנַמִּ֣ית הַזֹּ֔את וַיִּקְרָאֶ֖הָ וַתָּב֣וֹא אֵלָ֑יו וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שְׂאִ֥י בְנֵֽךְ׃

controles.web: He called Gehazi, and said, “Call this Shunammite!” So he called her.   When she had come in to him, he said, “Take up your son.”
controles.kjv: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.
controles.livre: Então ele chamou a Geazi, e disse-lhe: Chama a esta sunamita. E ele a chamou. E entrando ela, ele lhe disse: Toma teu filho.

versos.hebraico: וַתָּבֹא֙ וַתִּפֹּ֣ל עַל־רַגְלָ֔יו וַתִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ אָ֑רְצָה וַתִּשָּׂ֥א אֶת־בְּנָ֖הּ וַתֵּצֵֽא׃פ

controles.web: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground; and she took up her son, and went out.
controles.kjv: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.
controles.livre: E assim que ela entrou, lançou-se a seus pés, e inclinou-se a terra: depois tomou seu filho, e saiu-se.

versos.hebraico: וֶאֱלִישָׁ֞ע שָׁ֤ב הַגִּלְגָּ֨לָה֙ וְהָרָעָ֣ב בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּבְנֵי֙ הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים יֹשְׁבִ֖ים לְפָנָ֑יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְנַעֲר֗וֹ שְׁפֹת֙ הַסִּ֣יר הַגְּדוֹלָ֔ה וּבַשֵּׁ֥ל נָזִ֖יד לִבְנֵ֥י הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃

controles.web: Elisha came again to Gilgal. There was a famine in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and he said to his servant, “Set on the great pot, and boil stew for the sons of the prophets.”
controles.kjv: And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and there was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him: and he said unto his servant, Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets.
controles.livre: E Eliseu se voltou a Gilgal. Havia então grande fome na terra. E os filhos dos profetas estavam com ele, pelo que disse a seu criado: Põe uma grande caçarola, e faze sopa para os filhos dos profetas.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּצֵ֨א אֶחָ֣ד אֶל־הַשָּׂדֶה֮ לְלַקֵּ֣ט אֹרֹת֒ וַיִּמְצָא֙ גֶּ֣פֶן שָׂדֶ֔ה וַיְלַקֵּ֥ט מִמֶּ֛נּוּ פַּקֻּעֹ֥ת שָׂדֶ֖ה מְלֹ֣א בִגְד֑וֹ וַיָּבֹ֗א וַיְפַלַּ֛ח אֶל־סִ֥יר הַנָּזִ֖יד כִּֽי־לֹ֥א יָדָֽעוּ׃

controles.web: One went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered of it wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of stew; for they didn’t recognize them.
controles.kjv: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.
controles.livre: E saiu um ao campo a colher ervas, e achou uma como parreira selvagem, e agarrou dela uma capa de frutos silvestres; e voltou, e cortou-as na caçarola da sopa: porque não sabia o que era.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽצְק֥וּ לַאֲנָשִׁ֖ים לֶאֱכ֑וֹל וַ֠יְהִי כְּאָכְלָ֨ם מֵהַנָּזִ֜יד וְהֵ֣מָּה צָעָ֗קוּ וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ מָ֤וֶת בַּסִּיר֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יָכְל֖וּ לֶאֱכֹֽל׃

controles.web: So they poured out for the men to eat. As they were eating some of the stew, they cried out, and said, “Man of God, there is death in the pot!” They could not eat of it.
controles.kjv: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O thou man of God, there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.
controles.livre: Serviu depois para que comessem os homens; mas sucedeu que comendo eles daquele guisado, deram vozes, dizendo: Homem de Deus, há morte na caçarola! E não o puderam comer.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ וּקְחוּ־קֶ֔מַח וַיַּשְׁלֵ֖ךְ אֶל־הַסִּ֑יר וַיֹּ֗אמֶר צַ֤ק לָעָם֙ וְיֹאכֵ֔לוּ וְלֹ֥א הָיָ֛ה דָּבָ֥ר רָ֖ע בַּסִּֽיר׃ס

controles.web: But he said, “Then bring meal.” He cast it into the pot; and he said, “Pour out for the people, that they may eat.” There was no harm in the pot.
controles.kjv: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.
controles.livre: Ele então disse: Trazei farinha. E espalhou-a na caçarola, e disse: Dá de comer à gente. E não houve mais mal na caçarola.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֨ישׁ בָּ֜א מִבַּ֣עַל שָׁלִ֗שָׁה וַיָּבֵא֩ לְאִ֨ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים לֶ֤חֶם בִּכּוּרִים֙ עֶשְׂרִֽים־לֶ֣חֶם שְׂעֹרִ֔ים וְכַרְמֶ֖ל בְּצִקְלֹנ֑וֹ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר תֵּ֥ן לָעָ֖ם וְיֹאכֵֽלוּ׃

controles.web: A man from Baal Shalishah came, and brought the man of God bread of the first fruits, twenty loaves of barley, and fresh ears of grain in his sack. He said, “Give to the people, that they may eat.”
controles.kjv: And there came a man from Baal–shalisha, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.
controles.livre: Veio então um homem de Baal-Salisa, o qual trouxe ao homem de Deus pães de primícias, vinte pães de cevada, e trigo novo em sua espiga. E ele disse: Da ao povo, para que comam.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ מְשָׁ֣רְת֔וֹ מָ֚ה אֶתֵּ֣ן זֶ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י מֵ֣אָה אִ֑ישׁ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר תֵּ֤ן לָעָם֙ וְיֹאכֵ֔לוּ כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה אָכֹ֥ל וְהוֹתֵֽר׃

controles.web: His servant said, “What, should I set this before a hundred men?”   But he said, “Give the people, that they may eat; for thus says Yahweh, ‘They will eat, and will have some left over.’”
controles.kjv: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus saith the Lord, They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.
controles.livre: E respondeu seu servente: Como porei isto diante de cem homens? Mas ele voltou a dizer: Da ao povo para que comam, porque assim disse o SENHOR: Comerão, e sobrará.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֧ן לִפְנֵיהֶ֛ם וַיֹּאכְל֥וּ וַיּוֹתִ֖רוּ כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: So he set it before them, and they ate, and left some of it, according to Yahweh’s word.
controles.kjv: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of the Lord.
controles.livre: Então ele o pôs diante deles, e comeram, e sobrou-lhes, conforme a palavra do SENHOR.
